sql: SELECT name FROM sales.store ORDER BY name
SELECT count(*) FROM sales.customer
SELECT territoryid, count(*) AS customers FROM sales.customer GROUP BY territoryid ORDER BY customers DESC
SELECT p.name, sum(d.orderqty) AS units FROM sales.salesorderdetail d JOIN production.product p ON p.productid = d.productid GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT date_trunc('month', orderdate) AS month, sum(totaldue) AS revenue FROM sales.salesorderheader GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT extract(year FROM orderdate) AS year, count(*) FROM sales.salesorderheader GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_part('quarter', orderdate) AS q, round(avg(subtotal), 2) FROM sales.salesorderheader GROUP BY 1
SELECT to_char(orderdate, 'YYYY-MM') AS ym, count(*) FROM sales.salesorderheader GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT jobtitle, age(hiredate::timestamp) AS tenure FROM humanresources.employee ORDER BY tenure DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT count(*) FROM sales.salesorderheader WHERE orderdate >= make_date(2013, 1, 1) AND orderdate < make_date(2014, 1, 1)
SELECT count(*) FROM sales.salesorderheader WHERE orderdate BETWEEN DATE '2013-01-01' AND DATE '2013-01-01' + INTERVAL '30 days'
SELECT count(*) FROM sales.salesorderheader WHERE orderdate < current_date
SELECT current_timestamp, current_timestamp(0), localtimestamp, localtimestamp(2)
SELECT productid, round(listprice, 1), floor(listprice), ceil(standardcost), abs(listprice - standardcost) FROM production.product
SELECT lower(name), upper(name), trim(name), length(name), substring(name FROM 1 FOR 3), replace(name, ' ', '_'), split_part(name, ' ', 1), position('a' IN name) FROM production.product
SELECT trim(leading 'A' FROM name), trim(trailing 's' FROM name), btrim(name) FROM production.product
SELECT concat(firstname, ' ', lastname) AS full_name FROM person.person ORDER BY lastname, firstname
SELECT territoryid, string_agg(name, ', ' ORDER BY name) FROM sales.salesterritory GROUP BY territoryid
SELECT bool_and(makeflag), bool_or(finishedgoodsflag) FROM production.product
SELECT min(listprice), max(listprice), avg(listprice), sum(listprice) FROM production.product WHERE listprice > 0
SELECT name, listprice, rank() OVER (ORDER BY listprice DESC), dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY listprice DESC) FROM production.product
SELECT productsubcategoryid, name, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY productsubcategoryid ORDER BY listprice DESC) AS rn FROM production.product
SELECT orderdate, totaldue, lag(totaldue) OVER w, lead(totaldue, 2) OVER w FROM sales.salesorderheader WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY orderdate)

SELECT name, ntile(4) OVER (ORDER BY listprice), first_value(name) OVER (ORDER BY listprice), last_value(name) OVER (ORDER BY listprice ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) FROM production.product

WITH ranked AS (SELECT productsubcategoryid, name, listprice, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY productsubcategoryid ORDER BY listprice DESC) AS rn FROM production.product) SELECT productsubcategoryid, name, listprice FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 3
WITH orders AS (SELECT customerid, count(*) AS n FROM sales.salesorderheader GROUP BY customerid), big AS (SELECT customerid FROM orders WHERE n > 10) SELECT count(*) FROM big
WITH RECURSIVE n(i) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT i + 1 FROM n WHERE i < 10) SELECT i FROM n
WITH pg_user AS (SELECT 1 AS usename) SELECT usename FROM pg_user
SELECT name FROM production.product WHERE productid IN (SELECT productid FROM sales.salesorderdetail WHERE orderqty > 30)
SELECT s.name FROM sales.store s WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sales.customer c WHERE c.storeid = s.businessentityid)
SELECT name FROM production.product WHERE listprice > ANY (SELECT standardcost FROM production.product WHERE color = 'Red')
SELECT name, listprice - (SELECT avg(listprice) FROM production.product) AS diff FROM production.product
SELECT t.territoryid, t.total FROM (SELECT territoryid, sum(totaldue) AS total FROM sales.salesorderheader GROUP BY territoryid) t ORDER BY t.total DESC
SELECT t.name, latest.orderdate FROM sales.salesterritory t, LATERAL (SELECT orderdate FROM sales.salesorderheader h WHERE h.territoryid = t.territoryid ORDER BY orderdate DESC LIMIT 1) latest
SELECT p.name FROM production.product p LEFT JOIN sales.salesorderdetail d ON d.productid = p.productid WHERE d.productid IS NULL

SELECT pc.name AS category, count(*) FROM production.product p JOIN production.productsubcategory ps ON ps.productsubcategoryid = p.productsubcategoryid JOIN production.productcategory pc ON pc.productcategoryid = ps.productcategoryid GROUP BY pc.name
SELECT p.firstname, e.jobtitle FROM person.person p JOIN humanresources.employee e USING (businessentityid)
SELECT name FROM sales.store UNION SELECT name FROM production.product ORDER BY 1
(SELECT productid FROM sales.salesorderdetail INTERSECT SELECT productid FROM production.product) EXCEPT SELECT productid FROM production.productinventory
SELECT v.code, v.label FROM (VALUES ('US', 'United States'), ('CA', 'Canada')) AS v(code, label)
SELECT CASE WHEN color IS NULL THEN 'none' ELSE color END, coalesce(size, 'n/a'), nullif(weight, 0), greatest(listprice, standardcost), least(listprice, standardcost) FROM production.product

SELECT listprice::int, listprice::bigint, listprice::smallint, CAST(listprice AS numeric(10, 2)), listprice::real, listprice::double precision, name::text, name::varchar(10), color::char(3), sellstartdate::date, sellstartdate::timestamptz, makeflag::boolean FROM production.product
SELECT avg(shipdate - orderdate)::interval FROM sales.salesorderheader
SELECT name FROM production.product WHERE name LIKE 'Mountain%' OR name ILIKE '%bike%' OR listprice BETWEEN 10 AND 20
SELECT DISTINCT color FROM production.product WHERE color IS NOT NULL ORDER BY color
SELECT DISTINCT ON (customerid) customerid, orderdate FROM sales.salesorderheader ORDER BY customerid, orderdate DESC
SELECT salespersonid, sum(totaldue) FROM sales.salesorderheader WHERE salespersonid IS NOT NULL GROUP BY salespersonid HAVING sum(totaldue) > 1000000
SELECT territoryid, count(*) FROM sales.customer GROUP BY ROLLUP (territoryid)
SELECT name FROM production.product ORDER BY name OFFSET 10 ROWS FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
SELECT salesorderid FROM sales.salesorderdetail LIMIT 100000
SELECT "group", count(*) FROM sales.salesterritory GROUP BY "group"
SELECT count(*) FROM production.product WHERE makeflag IS TRUE AND finishedgoodsflag IS NOT FALSE
SELECT name FROM production.product WHERE color IN ('Red', 'Black') OR color = ANY (ARRAY['Blue', 'Silver'])
SELECT count(*) FROM production.product WHERE color IS DISTINCT FROM 'Red'
SELECT name FROM production.product ORDER BY name COLLATE "C"
SELECT pg_catalog.lower(name) FROM sales.store
SELECT 1 /* ; DELETE FROM sales.customer; SELECT * FROM person.password */
SELECT name FROM sales.store WHERE name = 'x''; DROP TABLE sales.store; --'
SELECT businessentityid, emailaddress FROM person.emailaddress
SELECT e.emailaddress AS contact FROM person.emailaddress e
SELECT * FROM person.emailaddress
SELECT p.firstname, ph.* FROM person.person p JOIN person.personphone ph ON ph.businessentityid = p.businessentityid
SELECT count(*), max(modifieddate) FROM person.emailaddress WHERE businessentityid < 100
SELECT emailaddress FROM person.emailaddress ORDER BY businessentityid
SELECT e.jobtitle, e.hiredate, e.gender FROM humanresources.employee e WHERE e.currentflag
SELECT cardtype, count(*) FROM sales.creditcard GROUP BY cardtype
SELECT firstname, lastname, persontype FROM person.person WHERE emailpromotion > 0 ORDER BY lastname
SELECT jobcandidateid, businessentityid FROM humanresources.jobcandidate
SELECT reviewername, emailaddress, rating FROM production.productreview ORDER BY rating DESC
SELECT count(*) FROM humanresources.employee
SELECT 1 + 1 AS two, 'text' AS label, NULL AS nothing, true AS yes
